newsitem.title: UK: PDFM keeps open mind on Sears.
newsitem.headline: PDFM keeps open mind on Sears.

text.p: Philips & Drew Fund Management will keep "an open mind" on Sears Plc management ahead of meetings with executives of the British retailer later this week, a spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman for PDFM, which holds an 11.8 percent stake in the retailer, said fund managers would make no further comment ahead of the meetings.
Retail analysts said institutional investors in the group have been threatening to force out chief executive Liam Strong because of Sears poor performance.
Strong announced on Monday the sale of Sears' mail order arm Freemans to Littlewoods plus a proposed cash payout to shareholders of 410 million pounds.

But he is under pressure to take more radical steps to try and revive Sears' performance, including the sale of British Shoe Corporation and also the possible demerger of flagship department store Selfridges.
